opener_concept: A number machine multiplies (x-1)(x-4). Testing x=5 (both brackets positive, product +4) then x=2.5 (one positive, one negative, product negative) shows a positive times a negative is negative, so the expression drops below zero only BETWEEN the two roots. The reveal names 'between the roots' as the whole method.
